precondition: An authenticated Admin has the Create Brand form open
No Site has been added yet
TC-010.descriptionLong: Verify the Save button stays disabled until at least one Site is configured for the Brand.

precondition: An authenticated Admin has filled all required Brand fields
TC-011.descriptionLong: Verify a new Brand is created with status Active and appears in the Brand list immediately after save.

precondition: An authenticated Admin has selected an existing Brand code
TC-012.descriptionLong: Verify an inline error is shown when the submitted Brand code already exists, without a full-page reload.

precondition: An authenticated Admin submits directly via API, bypassing the UI
TC-013.descriptionLong: Verify creating a Brand with a duplicate code is rejected with 409 and error code BRAND_CODE_ALREADY_EXISTS.

precondition: A Brand exists with status Inactive
TC-014.descriptionLong: Verify an inactive Brand cannot be referenced by a new Signal Config — the API returns 409 with a clear error code.

precondition: At least one Active and one Inactive Brand exist
TC-015.descriptionLong: Verify the Brand list can be filtered by status and shows the correct badge colour for each state.

precondition: A Brand exists with one or more Sites configured
TC-016.descriptionLong: Verify the Brand read model returns its full list of Sites with EcomConfig, matching what was persisted on create.
